# Vector creation, indexing, and replacement drill bank

These canonical questions drill vector construction, assignment, extraction with single brackets, repeated subsetting, vector-returning functions inside brackets, and replacement through vector subscripts.

Authoring policy for this bank:

- do not drill integer `L` suffixes, complex numbers, scientific notation, zero subscripts, logical recycling, duplicate element names, names containing spaces, typed `NA_*` constants, or the fact that names are preserved by subscripting;
- use student-facing variable names of at least two characters, with varied lowercase, uppercase, dot, and underscore styles;
- accept `T`/`F` anywhere `TRUE`/`FALSE` would work;
- use plain `NA` for missing values;
- vector-construction questions assign the vector to a specified variable;
- ordinary subscript questions accept any expression inside `[ ]` that produces the correct result;
- function-in-brackets questions name the function/operator to practice and briefly state what it returns;
- every logic family has four literal variants (`a` through `d`) that change names, values, and, where applicable, subscripts without changing the underlying skill.


<!-- question: vector_c01a -->
## Vector Drill C01a: Plain numeric vector using `c()`

Using `c()`, create the numeric vector `2, 5, 9, 14` in that order. Assign it to `scores`, then put `scores` on the final line.

```{r vector_c01a, exercise=TRUE, topic="vector_creation"}

```

```{r vector_c01a-solution}
scores <- c(2, 5, 9, 14)
scores
```

```{r vector_c01a-check}
  grade_this({
    calls <- walk_calls(parse_student_code(.user_code))
    assigned <- any(vapply(calls, function(cc) {
      hh <- call_head(cc)
      if (hh %in% c("<-", "=", "<<-") && length(cc) >= 3) {
        return(is.symbol(cc[[2]]) && identical(as.character(cc[[2]]), "scores"))
      }
      if (hh %in% c("->", "->>") && length(cc) >= 3) {
        return(is.symbol(cc[[3]]) && identical(as.character(cc[[3]]), "scores"))
      }
      if (identical(hh, "assign") && length(cc) >= 3) {
        target <- cc[[2]]
        return(is.character(target) && length(target) == 1 &&
                 identical(target, "scores"))
      }
      FALSE
    }, logical(1)))
    if (!assigned) {
      fail("Assign the vector to `scores` as requested.")
    }
    if (!uses_call(.user_code, "c")) {
  fail("Use `c()` as requested.")
}
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(.result, c(2, 5, 9, 14), check.attributes = TRUE))) {
      fail("The assigned vector does not match the requested values and names.")
    }
    pass("Correct.")
  })
```
<!-- /question -->

```{r vector_c08c-check}
  grade_this({
    calls <- walk_calls(parse_student_code(.user_code))
    assigned <- any(vapply(calls, function(cc) {
      hh <- call_head(cc)
      if (hh %in% c("<-", "=", "<<-") && length(cc) >= 3) {
        return(is.symbol(cc[[2]]) && identical(as.character(cc[[2]]), "visit_ids"))
      }
      if (hh %in% c("->", "->>") && length(cc) >= 3) {
        return(is.symbol(cc[[3]]) && identical(as.character(cc[[3]]), "visit_ids"))
      }
      if (identical(hh, "assign") && length(cc) >= 3) {
        target <- cc[[2]]
        return(is.character(target) && length(target) == 1 &&
                 identical(target, "visit_ids"))
      }
      FALSE
    }, logical(1)))
    if (!assigned) {
      fail("Assign the vector to `visit_ids` as requested.")
    }
    if (!uses_call(.user_code, "c")) {
  fail("Use `c()` as requested.")
}
if (!uses_call(.user_code, ":")) {
  fail("Use the `:` operator as requested.")
}
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(.result, c(20:22, 30:33), check.attributes = TRUE))) {
      fail("The assigned vector does not match the requested values and names.")
    }
    pass("Correct.")
  })
```

## Vector Drill E15a: Use `which()` inside brackets

`which()` returns the positions where a logical condition is `TRUE`. Use `which()` **inside `[ ]`** to return the values greater than 10 from `scores`.

```{r vector_e15a-setup, include=FALSE}
scores <- c(4,11,7,18,3,15)
```

```{r vector_e15a, exercise=TRUE, exercise.setup="vector_e15a-setup", topic="vector_indexing"}

```

```{r vector_e15a-solution}
scores[which(scores > 10)]
```

```{r vector_e15a-check}
  grade_this({
    if (!uses_call(.user_code, "[")) {
      fail("Use single-bracket vector subscripting (`[ ]`).")
    }
    calls <- walk_calls(parse_student_code(.user_code))
subscript_has_call <- any(vapply(calls, function(cc) {
  if (!identical(call_head(cc), "[") || length(cc) < 3) return(FALSE)
  subscripts <- as.list(cc)[-(1:2)]
  any(vapply(subscripts, function(node) {
    if (!is.call(node)) return(FALSE)
    nested_calls <- walk_calls(node)
    any(vapply(
      nested_calls,
      function(dd) identical(call_head(dd), "which"),
      logical(1)
    ))
  }, logical(1)))
}, logical(1)))
if (!subscript_has_call) {
  fail("Use `which()` inside the subscript as requested.")
}
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
      unname(.result),
      unname(scores[which(scores > 10)]),
      check.attributes = FALSE
    ))) {
      fail("The returned value or subvector is not correct.")
    }
    pass("Correct.")
  })
```

## Vector Drill E25a: Replace one subscripted value

The vector `scores` is provided. Replace **element 3** with `99` by assigning through a single-bracket subscript, then return the modified `scores`.

```{r vector_e25a-setup, include=FALSE}
scores <- c(10,20,30,40,50)
```

```{r vector_e25a, exercise=TRUE, exercise.setup="vector_e25a-setup", topic="vector_indexing", starter_question=TRUE}

```

```{r vector_e25a-solution}
scores[3] <- 99
scores
```

```{r vector_e25a-check}
grade_this({
  calls <- walk_calls(parse_student_code(.user_code))
  replacement <- any(vapply(calls, function(cc) {
    hh <- call_head(cc)
    if (!(hh %in% c("<-", "=", "<<-")) || length(cc) < 3) return(FALSE)
    lhs <- cc[[2]]
    is.call(lhs) &&
      identical(call_head(lhs), "[") &&
      length(lhs) >= 2 &&
      is.symbol(lhs[[2]]) &&
      identical(as.character(lhs[[2]]), "scores")
  }, logical(1)))
  if (!replacement) {
    fail("Replace the requested value(s) by assigning through `scores[...]`.")
  }
  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(.result, c(10, 20, 99, 40, 50), check.attributes = TRUE))) {
    fail("The vector after replacement is not correct.")
  }
  pass("Correct.")
})
```
